preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have been authorized by owner)
At least 2 minutes must have passed since last lunaburn call (lastSync + 2 minutes < block.timestamp)
Liquidity pool must contain LUNAINU tokens

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the lunaburn() function with percent_base1000 parameter set to 50 (maximum 5% of LP tokens). This will transfer up to 5% of the liquidity pool tokens from the pair contract directly to the owner's wallet. Ensure at least 2 minutes have passed since the last lunaburn call by checking the lastSync timestamp. The attack can be repeated every 2 minutes to continuously drain liquidity pool tokens.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract has a `lunaburn()` function that allows the owner to transfer up to 5% of the LP tokens from the pair contract directly to themselves. The function checks: 1) percent_base1000 ≤ 50 (max 5%), 2) at least 2 minutes have passed since last call, 3) LP has tokens. This is a classic owner privilege abuse where the owner can repeatedly drain liquidity pool tokens every 2 minutes.
attempts.attack_strategy: As the attacker, we need to impersonate the owner and call `lunaburn()` with maximum percent (50 = 5%). We must ensure the 2-minute cooldown has passed by warping time forward. The exploit will demonstrate the attacker's LUNAINU token balance increasing after the call.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Impersonate the contract owner using vm.prank. 2. Check if 2 minutes have passed since lastSync; if not, warp time forward. 3. Call lunaburn(50) to drain maximum allowed LP tokens. 4. Verify attacker's LUNAINU balance increased.

attempts.feedback: EVM Revert: Attacker balance should have increased after lunaburn: 0 <= 0。请调整参数或调用路径。

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The lunaburn function transfers LP tokens to msg.sender (the owner). To profit, we need those tokens to end up in our attacker's balance. We have two options: become the owner, or have the owner transfer tokens to us. Also, we need to ensure the LP has tokens by having the owner add liquidity first.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate owner to transfer ownership to our attacker. 2. As new owner, ensure LP has tokens (by adding liquidity if needed). 3. Call lunaburn(50) as owner (now our attacker). 4. Verify balance increase.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get current owner. 2. Impersonate owner to transfer ownership to attacker. 3. Accept ownership as attacker. 4. Add liquidity to create LP tokens (if needed). 5. Wait 2 minutes if needed. 6. Call lunaburn(50). 7. Verify balance increased.
attempts.failure_reflection: The previous PoC failed because: 1) The attacker's address (address(this) in test) wasn't the owner, so tokens went to the real owner address, not our attacker. 2) The LP pair might not have any tokens initially since all tokens are with the contract creator. 3) We need to first transfer ownership to our attacker or have the owner transfer stolen tokens to us.
